verdict.rationale: Eqvista is a SaaS equity-management platform, so headless or CI automation through an API or CLI is a fair question, and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only web-app and support-center workflows (migration, spreadsheet import, reports, e-signing). It shows no API, CLI, SDK or headless execution mode. The llms.txt file is a site description for AI readers, not a way to run the product headlessly, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
